[[File:Dominic Gaudreault Worlds 2002.jpg|thumb|right|200px|Dominic Gaudreault at the 2002 ''Lord of the Rings'' TCG World Championship.]]
'''Dominic Gaudreault''' took the 12th and last Day 3 slot at the [[2000 Decipher World Championship]] (Day 2: 10 / +70) and finished 5th on Day 3.
